_how: Copy this file to jobs/config.json and edit it. roles: words a job title must contain to be kept (any one of them). exclude: words that rule a title out. Leave roles empty to use the built-in example, which keeps product and UX design titles. cities: places you would work in person, matched against the posting's location. allow_remote: keep remote jobs you can do from remote_country. seniority: your level, kept for your own reference and never used to filter. skip_defense: true hides defense and national security roles. include_contract: true keeps contract and temporary roles. lower_tags: product areas to rank one tier lower (see jobs/fit.py TAGS). The rest switch extra job sources on or off.
